explanations: UpdatePrice evicts the cache entry and only then writes the new price to the store. In the gap between those two steps, any concurrent reader misses the cache, reads the old row from the store, and puts the old price back in the cache. The update then commits, but nothing evicts the entry again, so readers keep getting the stale price. On busy products a reader almost always lands in that gap. The fix writes to the store first and invalidates afterwards, so any entry cached after the eviction was read after the commit and is fresh. It also leaves the cache untouched when the save fails.
